title: Herzberg: hygiene factors and motivators
caption: Good hygiene factors only stop people being dissatisfied; they do not motivate. The motivators are what create satisfaction, which is why job enrichment gives people more responsibility.
alt: Two boxes: hygiene factors (pay, working conditions, company policy, supervision, job security) and motivators (achievement, recognition, the work itself, responsibility, advancement).
description: Hygiene factors: pay, working conditions, company policy, supervision, job security. If poor they cause dissatisfaction; if good they only prevent it.
Motivators: achievement, recognition, the work itself, responsibility, advancement. They create satisfaction and motivation.
